title: Correct landing speed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 20 m/s.

title: Correct window height difference
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 2.25 m.

title: Use of kinematic equations
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the constant-acceleration kinematic equations (e.g., v² = u² + 2as, s = ut + ½at²) for free fall.

title: Time calculation for window passage
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the given 0.3 s passage time to find the time to reach the bottom edge of the window.

title: Consistent sign convention
description: Important: The solution must use a consistent sign convention for displacement and acceleration due to gravity.

title: Unit analysis or inclusion
description: Optional: The final answers should include correct units (m/s and m).

title: Incorrect total fall time
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates the total time to fall 20 m (e.g., using t = h/v instead of t = √(2h/g)).

title: Misinterpreting window passage
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student treats the 0.3 s as the time to fall from the top edge of the window to the ground, or otherwise misapplies this time interval.
